while that write is in progress, zlog_unregister_client acquires client_lock, frees record_buffer, leaves the pointer unchanged, sets capacity to 0x800 and unlocks

impact: Potential write-after-free of a per-client record buffer during notification processing and concurrent client unregister. The mutex serializes each critical section but does not protect the buffer across zlog_write_internal, where the worker releases it.
